title: Open YouTube / App
description: Single-instance aware: switches to app if running (<1ms), or launches detached .desktop entry

title: Close Named App
description: Resolve target window via AppRegistry and close it with safety guardrails

title: Screenshot Active Window
description: Capture focused window bounding box directly to Wayland clipboard buffer and pictures via grim

title: Full Screenshot
description: Capture entire monitor output canvas to Wayland clipboard buffer

title: Snip Area (slurp)
description: Launch slurp interactive selection box to snip custom desktop area

title: Recapture Last Area
description: Re-execute screen snip using the most recent bounding box coordinates

title: Open Terminal Here
description: Spawn kitty terminal directly in parent folder of selected items or active workspace

title: Type Clipboard Buffer
description: Inject clipboard text into active window via wtype with 500-char safety ceiling and newline stripping

title: Clear Clipboard
description: Empty the Wayland clipboard buffer via wl-copy --clear

title: Strip Clipboard Formatting
description: Strip rich HTML/RTF types, recopying buffer strictly as clean text/plain

title: Scroll Down
description: Dispatch downward page/container scrolling to active window (<15ms) without LLM

title: Scroll Up
description: Dispatch upward scrolling to active window (<15ms)

title: Focus Search Field
description: Query active window AT-SPI accessibility tree, fuzzy-ground name, and focus input field

title: Search For Query
description: One-shot macro: focus search bar, replace text, type query, and press Return in <200ms
